name: uifoundation
description: Teaches coding agents to build AppKit UI on UIFoundation: the widgets, stacks, result builders and .box helpers to reach for instead of hand-rolling, their traps, and an app settings layer on PersistentSettings.

interface.shortDescription: AppKit UI and app settings on UIFoundation
interface.longDescription: Two skills for projects that depend on UIFoundation. uifoundation-widgets: what the library already provides before hand-rolling AppKit code — scrollable view factories, .box cell reuse, VStackView / HStackView, the NSToolbar and NSMenu result builders — and the traps in Label, ScrollView and the builders. uifoundation-settings-layer: an app's settings layer on PersistentSettings and SettingsStore, including the two rules whose violation silently stops settings from persisting. Requires the UIFoundation package (Swift Package Manager).
